name: smells_like_a_texas_tech_win
description:
Tired of white-knuckling your way through another Texas Tech game?  Then you need our “Smells Like a Texas Tech Win” candle - your new favorite pre-game superstition, emotional support system, and rally cry all rolled into one.

Hand-poured from 100% natural soy wax and scented with bold notes of desert winds, gameday adrenaline, and the faint aroma of tortilla confetti raining down from the stands - this candle is here to carry you through fourth-down drama and overtime miracles.

It’s rugged, defiant, and as comforting as a double-OT comeback in The Jones. Whether you’re lighting it for good luck, trying to calm your nerves during a goal-line stand, or just covering up the scent of nervous nachos, this candle rides with you - guns up.

A must-have for any Red Raider who believes in grit, guts, and that this just might be the year we shock the world.

Wreck ‘Em Tech!
